answers.how: The dragon moves approximately 273 px/s, giving 1.29/273 m per pixel. Its head-to-tail length is about 184 px.
The maximum visible wingspan is approximately 347 px. Using the speed-derived scale of 1.29/273 m per pixel gives 1.64 m.
The dragon moves straight over the 0.5-second interval, so its displacement is 1.29 × 0.5 = 0.645 m.
